thread:
Lina Gomez: Quick follow-up from the 03:40UTC tail spike. We saw p99 jump with throughput backpressure when ingestion >600rps. Need a short SLO plan + owners.

Rajiv Kumar: Can you share the rough numbers and where it's happening?

Lina Gomez: Infra-side: KV write backlog + bursty feeder batches. Baseline 800rps -> spike 1200rps; p99 220ms -> 520ms. Estimated extra burn ~1.8% of daily p99 error budget.

Owen Lee: Two immediate options: ingress smoothing or temporary SLO concession. Smoothing avoids exposing customers but takes a few hours to rollout. SLO concession buys engineers time.

Tasha (ops): Ops prefers SLO concession + ingress smoothing. We'll log the SLA note and auto-revert.

Lina Gomez: Proposed short plan: 1) Temp SLO: bump p99 to 350ms for 72h (owner Tasha, apply now, auto-revert) 2) Feeder smoothing: reduce burst cap (owner Owen, 24h, canary rollout) 3) KV-driver mitigation: patch to batch fsyncs (owner Rajiv, 4d) 4) Observability: add p99-by-prefix heatmap + sustained alert (owner Lina, 48h) 5) Recurrence watch: ticket that counts events and auto-triggers mitigation if >=2 in 30d (owner Lina, 7d).

slo-bot: Suggested commit message: "temporary: bump p99 SLO to 350ms for 72h - INF-4610"

Rajiv Kumar: I'll take the driver fix. Prototyping an fsync-batching toggle. ETA ~4d, will open INF-4611.

Owen Lee: I'll push the feeder smoothing PR with canary steps (10%->50%->100%) and include perf artifacts. ETA 18h. PR will include a synthetic probe.

Tasha (ops): Applying the SLO change now and adding SLA note. Making sure billing/metrics unaffected. I'll also set governance: any concession >6h requires postmortem within 7d.

Lina Gomez: Observability query (PromQL):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{route=~"/cache/.*"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Alerting: warn >300ms (5m), page >350ms (10m). Also add throughput SLO: 95th >= 750rps; fallback route low-priority traffic if throughput <600rps for >10m.

Owen Lee: Adding a 30s cadence probe to the canary namespace to catch write-latency and write-size distribution. ETA 24h.

Lina Gomez: Recurrence automation: INF-4612 "recurrence-watch: ingestion-pressure" to count events and auto-open mitigation. Owner Lina, ETA 7d.

incident-bot: Created INF-4610 "SLO concession: p99 temporary increase + ingress smoothing" and linked thread.

Rajiv Kumar: Note: relaxing SLO reduces immediate burn but we need stricter governance around repeated concessions. Good call on postmortem requirement.

Tasha (ops): I'll post a short announcement after SLO change is live and update the SLA doc. Also ensure auto-revert is enforced.

Lina Gomez: Recap owners: Tasha (SLO change, SLA note, governance), Owen (feeder smoothing + probe), Rajiv (driver patch INF-4611), Lina (observability + recurrence ticket INF-4612). We'll do a 10m sync at 15:30 UTC to confirm. Close when INF tickets and PRs are referenced.

Owen Lee: :thumbsup:

Rajiv Kumar: On it.

Tasha (ops): Posting announcement now.
